metadata.title: Retro Studio Portrait with Geometric Color Blocks

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a male subject seated in a stylized studio environment characterized by large, flat geometric planes of primary blue and red. The subject holds a vintage telephone receiver, creating a diagonal line across the torso, while the background features a stark, high-contrast blue panel set against a neutral wall.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned centrally against a large blue geometric backdrop
Red horizontal plane serving as the seating surface and lower anchor
Typography aligned to the upper right quadrant in a stacked configuration
Diagonal tension created by the telephone cord and the subject's arm placement
coreInvariants: High-contrast primary color palette (Blue, Red, White)
Soft studio lighting with diffused shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium-full shot, subject occupies approximately 60% of vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large blue rectangular panel behind the subject's head and torso.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows the arm down to the red base, then moves up to the text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper right and left corners to balance the dense central figure.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cobalt blue used for the large background panel.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright red used for the foreground seating platform.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White used for the subject's shirt and the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background elements contrasting with the natural skin tones and denim of the subject.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to primary blue, primary red, white, and dark denim tones.

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating over the blue background panel

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both name and title to maintain a clean, utilitarian look.

candidateDirections.reason: Standard typewriter look with slab serifs.
More polished version of the typewriter aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man in a white shirt and jeans, sitting on a bright red platform. Behind him is a large, flat cobalt blue rectangular panel leaning against a light grey wall. He is holding a vintage black telephone receiver to his ear. The lighting is soft and even.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two blocks of white typewriter-style text in the top right corner. The top block should be two lines, and the bottom block should be three lines, both right-aligned.

verificationChecks: Are the blue and red colors vibrant and flat?
Is the font a monospaced slab serif?
Is the subject holding a vintage telephone?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of blue for the panel
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any visible brand logos on the telephone or clothing
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the blue panel has a distinct edge against the wall.
Check that the red platform provides a solid horizontal base.
Verify the text is white and clearly legible against the blue.
Confirm the 1980s studio aesthetic is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central portrait with high-contrast geometric color blocks and right-aligned typewriter text for a retro-modern editorial look.
